title: Proof of ns singularity descartes
html:
Proof. Proof of ns singularity descartes

Proof. The NS obstruction is \mathrm{NS}(A) = \kappa_0|_\Sigma where \mathrm{tr}(\kappa_0) = \chi(A) = -6.

Step 1 (arithmetic). For \kappa \geq 4, 2\kappa \geq 8 > 6 = |\chi(A)|, so 2\kappa \nmid -6. By the Kummer specialisation, \kappa_0 \bmod 2\kappa \neq 0 for all \kappa \geq 4. The obstruction survives through infinitely many levels of the Kummer tower.

Step 2 (algebra). The perpetual obstruction (item 3) says \kappa_0 and the jet corrections \delta_n live in complementary subgroups of H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}). The total obstruction \kappa_n|_\Sigma = \kappa_0|_\Sigma + \delta_n|_\Sigma is nonzero because the topological term \kappa_0|_\Sigma \neq 0 cannot be cancelled by the analytic term \delta_n|_\Sigma.

Step 3 (geometry). \mathrm{NS}(A) \neq 0 implies, via the core-Levi equivalence, that the Levi form stays non-degenerate at the collision locus: the contact structure does not degenerate.

Step 4 (dynamics). Non-degenerate Levi form implies bounded core aspect ratio, which gives the vorticity lower bound \|\omega\|_\infty \geq c/(T^*-t), which gives BKM divergence \int \|\omega\|_\infty \, dt = \infty.
